//: EXAMPLE with every field explained. Copy to swarm.config.json, edit, then run SETUP.cmd (dry run) and SETUP.cmd -Apply. JSON has no comments, so the help sits in '//' keys - they are ignored.

paths.//root: Install folder (where L2Swarm.exe, Scripts, Settings, Dashboard, docs live). Leave empty = the folder this file is in. Only set it if the config lives elsewhere.
paths.//l2Client: The game client l2.exe. Only needed for characters with clientMode 'ingame' (L2Swarm's Hook button starts it).

server.//: Lineage 2 server. loginIp/loginPort/serverId are written into every account config; gameIp/gamePort is only used to test whether the server is up (reconnect brake in l2swarm_ctl.ps1).
server.name: L2Toggle

mcp.//: L2Swarm's MCP server port (written into Settings\settings.xml; Claude Code connects to http://127.0.0.1:<port>).

dashboard.//: Dashboard web server (Dashboard\server.js). keyFile = password for phone/LAN access (?key=...), created by SETUP when missing.

l2swarm.//: minimizeWindow: true = the MemWatch task (l2swarm_ctl.ps1 watch) minimizes L2Swarm's window every 2 min (old UI-deadlock workaround from before 3.8.14). Default false: the window is left alone.

login.//: Seconds between two account logins at start (never below 5: the login server refuses mass logins). SETUP also writes it to Settings\login_gap.txt.

//mainLeader: Character that leads the main party and may give commands to everyone (swarm.js CONFIG.leader).
//clanLeader: Character that owns the clan (clan jobs; used when Scripts\data\clan_quests.json has no leader).
//commanders: Optional: characters (yours, or anyone you trust, also a character you play by hand) whose ! commands every party leader obeys. In game CLAN chat: "@!level" (= clan prefix @ + !level) = every party leader runs !level for his party; "@Leadername !supply" = only that party (several: "@Leader1,Leader2 !stop"). A WHISPER to a party leader (in game: a double quote right before his name, then the command: "Leadername !town giran) = his party. The leader relays it in party chat like his own order and whispers back ok: <command>. Party leaders must be in the clan to hear clan chat. Read live (30 s), no restart. Empty = off.
//dailyLeaders: Party leaders that run the daily Kamaloka (dashboard Kamaloka tab).
//dailyHallTeam: Optional, OLD global list: the (max 6) characters that run a Kamaloka HALL (6-man instance) — only for the party whose leader is in it. Prefer kamaloka.hallTeams.
//kamaloka: hallTeams: party leader -> the 2-6 characters (leader included) that go into a Kamaloka Hall when the party is bigger than 6; the others wait in the captain's town and rejoin after. Edited on the dashboard (Kamaloka -> party row -> Hall team), read live by swarm.js. A party without one gets an automatic team per Hall (leader, tank, up to 2 healers, strongest dealers in the level window).
//teamRoutes: Optional: party leader -> its own leveling route file in Scripts\data (default: custom_zones.json for everyone).

groups.//: L2Swarm account-list group per account. {party} = the party leader's character name. overrides: party leader -> group name.

//scripts: Scripts (files in Scripts\) every account starts with. SETUP adds missing ones to each account config.
//roleTemplates: role -> existing account config used as the template for NEW accounts of that role. SETUP copies it once to Settings\templates\<role>.xml with login, password and character removed. 'default' is used for roles without a template. On a new PC the templates in Settings\templates are used.
//boardBuffs: true (default) = Community Board buffs (L2Toggle-style servers): the party buffers only fill what the board lacks. false = old-school: no board buff runs at all, the party's own buffers (Prophet, Swordsinger, Bladedancer, Warcryer, Overlord, Elders, Doomcryer ...) are the buff source, self buffs / toggles / cubics are allowed. Per party: boardBuffs on the leader's account entry. Who buffs whom: Scripts\data\buff_plans.json (see buff_plans.example.json).
//townCommands: true (default) = the server has free .giran / .aden ... town commands (L2Toggle). false = gatekeepers and Scroll of Escape only (servers without .town). Without this switch the hive also falls back to gatekeepers after the server answers a .town command twice with Usage / unknown command.
//legacyConfigs: Old config files in Settings\ that SETUP must leave alone (never in AutoStart).
//accounts: One line per game account. Fields:
login      - account login name (required)
character  - the character to play on it (L2Swarm selects it by name). Empty = not created yet.
config     - file name in Settings\ (default: login with a capital first letter + .xml)
party      - character name of its party leader; the leader has party = its own name
role       - swarm.js role. A KIND (works for every class): tank, healer, buffer, melee, archer, dagger, nuker, summoner, spoiler, crafter,
or auto = the kind of the character's current class (Scripts\data\class_tree.json; re-checked after a class change).
Skills are found from the character's own learned skills (no skill ids). buffer on a fighter class (Swordsinger, Bladedancer,
Sword Muse, Spectral Dancer) assists in melee, on a mystic class (Prophet, Warcryer, Overlord, Doomcryer ...) stays back.
Or one of the named roles with special routines: sk (tank), bishop / shilliensaint (healer), destroyer (drain + Frenzy),
doombringer, necromancer, inspector (Soul Breaker / Soul Hound debuffs), doomcryer (chants), crafter (golem), spoiler.
boardBuffs - only on a party LEADER's entry: true / false for the whole party (overrides the top-level boardBuffs)
master     - optional note: which master account it belongs to
autoStart  - logged in by 'L2Swarm Start' (default true)
enabled    - false = ignored everywhere (default true)
clientMode - 'oog' (out of game, default) or 'ingame' (real game client via L2Swarm's Hook)
note       - free text
classPlan  - optional: the 3 class names for the Alt+B -> Career -> Professions changes at 20 / 40 / 76, e.g.
["Elven Wizard", "Spellsinger", "Mystic Muse"]. Default = the role's usual path (sk: Palus Knight -> Shillien Knight ->
Shillien Templar, bishop: Cleric -> Bishop -> Cardinal, destroyer: Orc Raider -> Destroyer -> Titan, ...).
REQUIRED for 'nuker' (depends on the race) - without it that character never changes class automatically.
PASSWORDS NEVER GO IN THIS FILE. SETUP -Apply creates a missing account config and asks for the password (hidden prompt),
or reads it from the environment variable SWARM_PW_<LOGIN> (e.g. SWARM_PW_MYLOGIN1) or SWARM_PASSWORD; only the encrypted
password is written into Settings\<config>.
